citation.authors: Brennan M, Young G, Devane D

record.design: Cochrane review of topical preparations to prevent stretch marks in pregnancy
record.finding: No statistically significant difference in developing stretch marks with topical preparations against placebo or no treatment (risk ratio 0.74, 95% CI 0.53 to 1.03).
record.note: 2012; ethnicity of participants not stated in the abstract.
